exposure: Birth weight of the second twin
outcome: Combined delivery (unplanned cesarean section for the second twin after vaginal delivery of the first twin)
cohort: 5411 women with twin pregnancy experiencing vaginal delivery of the first twin
finding: Delivery interval between twins was significantly associated with combined delivery and mediated the association between combined delivery and some other risk factors, including pre-pregnancy BMI and birth weight of the second twin.
mod_finding: Delivery interval was significantly associated with combined delivery and mediated the association between combined delivery and some other risk factors.
